title: Violin at nine, then piano with his sister
summary: He started on violin, disliked it, took piano at twelve with his sister, and gave it up for his father's trade.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: When did you take up music? How old were you about?
Nine years old I was taking music.
But I didn't keep it up. I didn't like the violin. I played a little while but I didn't like it.
Nine when I was taking violin. Oh nine. Nine years old. Then when I got around twelve I started taking piano with my sister. She plays piano.
Did anybody else in the family? Your mother or father play any music?

Just my sister. My sister plays piano. Well she fools with more opera than anything else. And I got to playing the piano a while. Well I got to playing jazz. Well they bored me off the piano. Well let me play the piano anymore. So I gave the piano. So I went to work with my daddy at the trade.
